candidates.title: JITServe: SLO-aware LLM Serving with Imprecise Request Information
candidates.reason: SLO-aware LLM serving system with grouped-margin goodput scheduling; reports 1.4x-6.3x service-goodput improvement and 28.5%-83.2% resource savings on realistic workloads.

candidates.title: CHIME: A Case for Efficient Long-Context Attention-FC Disaggregated Inference with DIMM-PIM
candidates.reason: Long-context attention/FC disaggregated inference using DIMM-PIM with explicit communication-computation overlap and scheduling; reports up to 5.15x speedup over HBM-PIM baselines.

candidates.title: ELIS: Efficient LLM Iterative Scheduling System with Response Length Predictor
candidates.reason: Cloud-native Kubernetes LLM serving scheduler combining response-length prediction with iterative shortest-remaining-time-first scheduling; reports up to 19.6% average JCT reduction.

candidates.title: Characterizing and Optimizing LLM Inference Workloads on CPU-GPU Coupled Architectures
candidates.reason: ISPASS 2025 system characterization of PCIe A100/H100 versus GH200 LLM inference with kernel-level profiling and optimization implications for CPU-GPU coupling; directly relevant to heterogeneous inference architecture.

rejected_candidates.title: Optimizing LLM Inference Throughput via Memory-aware and SLA-constrained Dynamic Batching
rejected_candidates.rejection_reason: LLM serving scope is relevant, but the contribution is a comparatively narrow dynamic-batching policy with numerical experiments and limited system-level novelty versus the stronger scheduling systems selected in this round.

rejected_candidates.title: Mind the Memory Gap: Unveiling GPU Bottlenecks in Large-Batch LLM Inference
rejected_candidates.rejection_reason: Useful GPU bottleneck characterization, but its main contribution is analysis plus a batching configuration advisor rather than a sufficiently distinct inference-system mechanism for the current candidate pool.
